notes.title: Update 2.0 is here!
notes.content: [p]It’s been a while! How’s everyone doing?[/p][p]What’s New :[/p][p]- Fear Mechanic: Wasn’t working as intended. [/p][p]This was the key fix needed to add more challenge.[/p][p]- Levels: Reworked several areas, removed some sections, [/p][p]improved doors, and optimized level loading.[/p][p]- Fall Damage: Now properly interacts with the fear mechanic.[/p][p]- Options Menu: Added an FPS counter and more customization options.[/p][p]- Lighting & Fog: Adjusted lighting for levels with multiple visual issues,[/p][p] along with fog improvements.[/p][p]- Shooting Mechanic: Tweaked for better functionality.[/p]

notes.title: Update
notes.content: Reverted a change from the previous update, where the character would just spin around in circles. Major update 1.10 will be coming out this weekend
